# Promit Mitra — Portfolio

> A personal professional portfolio documenting Promit Mitra's work across B2B demand generation, account research, multichannel outreach, content operations, CRM workflows, RFP/proposal support, and brand/event communications.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://promit.qd.je/): Overview, selected work, working approach, and contact details.
- [About Promit Mitra](https://promit.qd.je/about.html): Professional profile, focus areas, documented evidence, and contact links.
- [CV](https://promit.qd.je/cv.html): Experience, education, skills, and certifications.

## Writing and discovery

- [Blog archive](https://promit.qd.je/blogs/): Current archive of published articles, generated from the site's blog sources.
- [XML sitemap](https://promit.qd.je/sitemap.xml): Indexable canonical HTML pages, including generated blog articles.
- [Sitemap index](https://promit.qd.je/sitemap_index.xml): Entry point for the XML sitemap.
- [Robots policy](https://promit.qd.je/robots.txt): Crawl policy and sitemap location.

## Selected work

- [B2B demand generation](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/b2b-demand-generation.html): Connecting buying signals, account research, outreach, CRM context, and sales handoff.
- [Whitepaper content operations](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/whitepaper-content-engine.html): Research, outlining, writing, editing, design, and distribution of seven whitepapers.
- [RFP and proposal operations](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/rfp-proposal-system.html): Opportunity research, client profiles, pitch decks, requirement mapping, team coordination, and submission support.
- [Lead lifecycle operations](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/lead-lifecycle-operations.html): Connecting calls, email, LinkedIn activity, CRM history, and follow-up.
- [Event and brand communications](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/event-brand-communications.html): Event visuals, promotional material, print collateral, and social content.
- [POSM Planner concept](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/posm-planner.html): A self-initiated concept-stage product idea for organising point-of-sale materials.

## Evidence and interpretation

- The portfolio reports 60+ institutional sites monitored, seven whitepapers worked on, and 12 bid/RFP submissions supported.
- Four of the 12 recorded RFP submissions received a client/procurement reply. This is a response measure, not a win rate or revenue claim.
- Employer/client identities, internal records, and proprietary assets are withheld. Process diagrams are reconstructions.
- POSM Planner is a concept, not a launched product or a claim of customer adoption.
